_readme: The experiment ledger. Every deliberate change that is supposed to move a search metric gets an entry BEFORE it ships, with a hypothesis and the metric that would settle it. `npm run experiments` joins each entry to Search Console around its ship date and reports what actually happened. Without this the repo ships and forgets: 70+ merged PRs and no way to attribute a single traffic movement to any of them. Statuses: open (shipped, waiting for data), concluded (we know), abandoned (superseded before it could be judged).

experiments.hypothesis: A Pointless answers archive captures 'answers/questions' demand that the game page itself does not rank for.
experiments.change: Published /football-pointless/answers — the full archive of past daily boards with the score each answer earned.
experiments.baseline: New URL — zero impressions before this date.

experiments.hypothesis: Putting the recognised alias 'Tiki Taka Toe' into the /tictactoe snippet converts impressions that already rank but never get clicked.
experiments.change: Added the alias to the meta description so the SERP snippet carries the term the body already ranked for.
experiments.baseline: 216 Bing impressions at position ~8 with 0.0% CTR (2026-09-19).

experiments.hypothesis: A descriptively-named Football Bingo page can rank, because the site wins on named-format queries (Pointless, Tenable) where competitors brand their clones instead.
experiments.change: Shipped Football Bingo as a new game on its own URL.
experiments.baseline: New URL — zero impressions before this date.

experiments.hypothesis: Football Contexto captures 'guess the footballer' demand that /teammates and /career-path do not reach.
experiments.change: Shipped Football Contexto as a new game on its own URL.
experiments.baseline: New URL — zero impressions before this date.

experiments.hypothesis: Giving the question builder its own URL captures 'build your own' demand that was invisible while it sat inside a tab.
experiments.change: Moved the builder onto /build-your-own-football-darts with its own SEO entry.
experiments.baseline: New URL — zero impressions before this date. Also the non-trademarked route into 501 demand (see B-027).

experiments.hypothesis: Removing the duplicate H1 on /tictactoe and matching the wordmark to the searched spelling ('Tic-Tac-Toe', not 'TicTacToe') helps a page that is currently position 8-9 on its main Bing pool.
experiments.change: Demoted the game menu heading to <h2> and renamed the wordmark; hub and Up Next labels follow.
experiments.baseline: Bing: 1,278 impressions at position 9, 0.7% CTR. Google: position 26.1 on 665 impressions (90d).

experiments.hypothesis: Spanish pages for Bingo and Contexto earn impressions, because Spanish converts unusually well here (85.7% CTR on one Bing query, 949s average session on /es).
experiments.change: Wrote Spanish SEO content for both games, replacing English fallback strings that were duplicating the English pages.
experiments.baseline: Both URLs existed but served duplicate English metadata.
